close_reason: Decision record — captures a settled architectural choice already implemented in the crate. No code action required. The bead description preserves the rationale for future readers searching by topic; closing keeps the autonomous frontier focused on actionable findings.
description: Cargo.toml HEAD has zero direct production deps on tokio, hyper, reqwest, tokio-tungstenite. All transport plumbing comes through jmap-base-client. Commit 46a8468 (cargo-machete sweep) deliberately removed direct tokio dep when nothing in the crate actually needed it at runtime. Dev-deps add only what examples specifically need (futures, tokio-tungstenite for ws_loop.rs; tokio net+io-util features for sse_listen.rs stub). A future contributor might propose 'just add tokio as a direct dep for convenience' — DO NOT accept. The transport-less posture is foundational to the kit-library design (workspace AGENTS.md 'What this workspace builds'). Loosening this without an architectural decision bead is scope creep.
title: DECISION: Cargo dev-deps minimally scoped; no production tokio/transport deps
